verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence never documents a user-configurable automation or workflow feature that runs on its own. Webhooks (tilled-docs-4) are developer building blocks for constructing automations, not the capability itself. Closing a batch via API (tilled-docs-35) is a one-off API action, not a recurring schedule. The subscriptions item (tilled-docs-13) only describes viewing and managing subscriptions in the Dashboard, not setting up autonomous automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
